CFG.GITLAB_BASE_URL: Vlastná základná adresa URL aplikácie GitLab (voliteľné)
CFG.FILTER_USER: Používateľské meno (napr. na odfiltrovanie vlastných zmien)
CFG.FILTER_USER_DESC: To filter out comments and other changes by yourself when polling for issue updates
CFG.SUBMIT_TIMELOGS: Odosielanie časových záznamov do systému Gitlab
CFG.SUBMIT_TIMELOGS_DESCRIPTION: Zobrazenie dialógového okna sledovania času po kliknutí na deň ukončenia

FORM_HELP:
Here you can configure SuperProductivity to list open GitLab (either its the online version or a self-hosted instance) issues for a specific project in the task creation panel in the daily planning view. They will be listed as suggestions and will provide a link to the issue as well as more information about it.

In addition you can automatically add and sync all open issues to your task backlog.
